question: If the 5-digit number 505xy is divisible by 11 and 21, then what is the value of (7x − 5y)?
solution:
**Given:**

505xy is divisible by 11 & 21

**Concept:**

When 505xy is divisible by 11 & 21, it will also be divisible by the LCM of 11 & 21.

Dividend = Divisor x Quotient + Remainder

**Calculation:**

LCM (11, 21) = 231

By taking the largest 5-digit number 50599 and divide it by 231.

⇒ 50599 = 231 × 219 + 10

⇒ 50599 = 50589 + 10

⇒ 50599 - 10 = 50589 (completely divisible by 231)

⇒ 50589 = 505xy (where x = 8, y = 9)

Now the value of (7x - 5y),

⇒ (7x - 5y) = 7 × 8 - 5 × 9

⇒ 56 - 45 = 11

**∴ The value of (7x - 5y) is 11.**
